name: Temple of Ephara
description: A temple to Ephara, one of which in a deserted city is where Ashiok creates Cacophony.

timeline.summary: In a dream, Melantha dines with her dead mentor Xenocrates, who drinks wine from a poisoned goblet and coughs up blood as he voices blasphemous theories; she wakes screaming.
timeline.quote: I did not... I did not kill you, Xenocrates.

timeline.summary: Xenocrates argues that gods are the patterns mortals recognize, personified through the power of Nyx, and that mortals are responsible for their gods; Melantha forbids it as blasphemy.
timeline.quote: Through the power of Nyx, we are responsible for our gods.

timeline.summary: Ashiok, whose concealment from Phenax's boon fades, reveals that they sculpted the dreams to create the god Cacophony as a display, hiding in an abandoned Ephara temple.
timeline.quote: The earth's rumbles faded to stillness as the last remnant of Phenax's glamour dissolved around Ashiok.

pages_say.description: The temple where Iris spends most of her time in luxury.
A temple to Ephara, one of which in a deserted city is where Ashiok creates Cacophony.
